def measure_print(guess, cams=["wrist"]):
    xyz, rgb, ci = ep.cloud(cams=cams, stride=1)
    m = (np.abs(xyz[:,0]-guess[0]) < 0.05) & (np.abs(xyz[:,1]-guess[1]) < 0.05) & (xyz[:,2] > 0.087) & (xyz[:,2] < 0.115)
    P = xyz[m]; col = rgb[m].astype(int)
    orange = (col[:,0] > 150) & (col[:,2] < 120) & (col[:,1] > 60); blue = (col[:,2] > 150) & (col[:,0] < 120)
    O = P[orange]; B = P[blue]
    topz = np.percentile(O[:,2], 90)
    topO = O[O[:,2] > topz - 0.003]
    sel = np.vstack([topO, B])
    best = []
    for phi in np.arange(0, 60, 0.5):
        ws = []; ctr = []
        for k in range(3):
            a = np.radians(phi + 60*k); d = sel[:, :2] @ np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a)])
            ws.append(d.max() - d.min()); ctr.append((d.max()+d.min())/2)
        best.append((sum(ws), phi, ws, ctr))
    best.sort(key=lambda t: t[0]); s, phi, ws, ctr = best[0]
    Nm = np.array([[np.cos(np.radians(phi+60*k)), np.sin(np.radians(phi+60*k))] for k in range(3)])
    cxy = np.linalg.lstsq(Nm, np.array(ctr), rcond=None)[0]
    A_ = np.c_[topO[:,0], topO[:,1], np.ones(len(topO))]
    coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A_, topO[:,2], rcond=None)
    tilt = np.degrees(np.arctan(np.hypot(coef[0], coef[1])))
    return dict(center=cxy, phi=phi, widths=np.round(ws,4), top_z=np.median(topO[:,2]), blue_ctr=B[:,:2].mean(0) if len(B) else None,
                blue_z=np.median(B[:,2]) if len(B) else None, tilt=tilt, n=len(sel), orange_zmin=np.percentile(O[:,2], 2))
